title: Trigger folder (map/triggers/**/_category.json)
description: A folder of the trigger tree: a category or a library (docs/trigger-folders-spec.md, section 2), read and written by crates/w3proj/src/trigger_layout.rs. Unknown keys are errors there, so they are refused here too.

type.description: 4 a category, 2 a library; 4 when missing

id.description: imported maps only, as stored (two folders may share one)

name.description: the name the tree shows; the folder's name is a slug of it

text.description: a name war3map.wtg stores: no zero character
